import.title: Import members
import.description: Upload a spreadsheet to invite many people at once. Nothing is created until you review and confirm.
import.template_body: Columns: email and role are required; display_name and send_invitation are optional. Roles are STUDENT, TEACHER, TEAM_LEAD, or MANAGER.
import.limits: Up to {{rows}} rows and {{size}} MB. CSV or XLSX.
import.upload_failed: That file could not be read.

reason.file_too_large: The file is larger than {{size}} MB.
reason.unsupported_format: Save the file as CSV or XLSX and try again.
reason.too_many_sheets: Keep the member list in a single sheet.
reason.too_many_rows: The file has more than {{rows}} data rows. Split it and import in batches.
reason.missing_header: The first row must name the columns.
reason.missing_required_column: The file needs an email column and a role column.
reason.unreadable: The file could not be read. Check that it is a valid CSV or XLSX.

import.blocked: Fix the errors in your spreadsheet and upload it again. Nothing has been created.
import.acknowledge: I have reviewed the warnings above
import.acknowledge_hint: Rows with warnings will be imported as shown.

error.email_invalid: That is not a valid email address
error.role_invalid: Not a role this academy has
error.duplicate_in_file: This address appears more than once in the file
error.membership_exists: Already a member of this academy
error.cell_too_long: A cell in this row is too long

warning.display_name_normalized: Extra spaces in the name were removed
warning.invitation_suppressed: No new invitation will be sent

outcome_code.row_invalid: The row could not be read

bulk.confirm_blocked: {{count}} cannot be changed and will be left alone.
bulk.confirm_none: Nobody in this selection can be changed.

consequence.teacher_assignments_stranded: {{count}} teach classes that will be left without a teacher
consequence.enrollments_dropped: {{count}} will lose their place in every class
consequence.last_manager_blocked: {{count}} cannot change: an academy must keep one active manager
consequence.ineligible: {{count}} are not eligible for this change

bulk.replayed: This change had already been applied. Nothing ran a second time.

delivery.title: Invitations
delivery.description: Every invitation and what happened to its email.
delivery.resend_hint: Resending replaces the old link. Anyone holding it can no longer use it.
delivery.resend_failed: That invitation could not be resent.

state_help.QUEUED: Waiting to be handed to the email provider.
state_help.SENT: The provider accepted it. Delivery is not confirmed yet.
state_help.DELIVERED: The receiving mail server accepted it.
state_help.BOUNCED: The address rejected it. Check the address before resending.
state_help.FAILED: It could not be handed over. Resend to try again.

delivery.empty_body: Invite someone, or import a member list, and their invitations will appear here.
